title: 269,605 NYC jobs
text: 269,605 people living in Nassau County hold jobs in New York City, with a typical straight-line commute of 28 km. Their households drive about 11,675 miles a year and emit about 14.4 t of CO₂ from driving and home energy, against 4.7 t and 3,015 miles for a household already living in the city’s car-light core.
source_label: Census LODES 2023 · BTS LATCH 2017 · EIA RECS 2020 · ACS 2020–24

title: $268 a Ton
text: Under Local Law 97, buildings over 25,000 square feet pay up to $268 for each ton of CO₂e above their annual cap, starting in 2024. It is the city’s own price on a ton.

title: 1.4% Vacant
text: In 2023, 1.4% of New York City’s rental apartments were vacant, the lowest rate since 1968.
source_label: NYC HPD, 2023 Housing and Vacancy Survey
